task_title: Floor 3 slice 12: onboarding, starter, and poach UX surfaces

plan_review.notes: Separate-model plan review before coding. Blockers: (1) headless runner only resolved the loadout pause once at floor start, so a mid-run poach would stall Floor 3 forever -> added generic mid-loop resolution; (2) pausing inside the studio-defeat loop could double-fire or interleave with terminal transitions -> offer is now raised at the top of a fresh playing tick behind a poachOffered latch; (3) reinterpreting a Studio as a Trainer -> offer contract kept generic (floor3PoachOffer) with Studio-handler defeat documented as its only current producer until roaming Trainers land; (4) candidates must carry the Trainer roster level -> Floor3PoachCandidate carries {speciesId, level} and recruits at that level. Non-blocking: never-strand fallback on out-of-range picks, and duplicate species collapsing to the highest level.

independent_grade.notes: The change cleanly ships three Floor 3 UX surfaces (rules briefing, starter picker, poach picker) by reusing the existing 'loadout' world state rather than adding a new one, keeping every existing consumer correct. The poach offer is raised at the top of a fresh 'playing' tick behind a per-encounter latch, so the defeat loop always completes before any pause and two same-tick Studio wipes yield two consecutive offers — the design's key invariant. The headless-runner mid-run loadout fix is correctly placed, generic, and matches the scene's own modal-reopen path. Layer boundaries are respected throughout: floor3-ux.ts is Phaser-free and importable from shared, MainGameScene is the only consumer of Phaser-coupled builder calls, and the sim-side dispatcher is wired through scenarioDefinitions. All changed behaviors are covered by unit tests, a real headless regression test, and an updated e2e characterisation guard. The 'poachOffered' latch is set before buildFloor3PoachOffer returns to prevent re-offer; the only undefined-return cases are intentional (party locked, Final Four, unknown species), and the degraded path logs a warning. No determinism violations, no Date.now/Math.random usage, and the lab is created and registered before the surface ships.
